global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender noodles and a single nori sheet resting atop. Served in a blue-and-white patterned bowl, it sits on a wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue geometric patterned rim, smooth glossy surface, circular shape, slightly raised edge.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is creamy beige, glossy, with tender noodles and green garnish floating on its surface.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark, textured, rectangular, with uneven edges and a slightly glossy surface.
